diagrams.title: ADR-001: Transitioning to V2 AuthorizationAS Deployment (diagram 1)
diagrams.code:
graph TD
    A[External Client] -->|"/auth/token"| B[Public Ingress]
    B --> C[api.authorization.svc.cluster.local/*]
    
    subgraph "Authorization K8s Namespace"
        C --> D[Internal API Gateway]
        D -->|"internal-token/ or .well-known/ or jwks.json"| E[Virtual Service V2]
        
        E --> G[Service V2]
        G --> H[Deployment V2]
        H --> I["image: authorizationas:2.0.0"]
    end

    
    subgraph "Default K8s Namespace"
        D -->|"/device-token or /token or /permissions"| F[Virtual Service V1]
        F --> J[Service V1]
        J --> K[Deployment V1]
        K --> L["image: authorizationas:1.2.3"]
    end
    
    M[Dev Proxy] -->|"authorization-service/token"| J
    N[Public Ingress V1] -->|"dev-eu.scalars-access.com/auth/token"| J
